independent_solution: The cyclist starts and ends at O, so (a) net displacement = 0 and (b) average velocity = 0/(10 min) = 0.
Fig. 3.20 (pinned page 21): P due east of O, Q due north, so arc PQ is a quarter circle: path = OP + arc PQ + QO = 1 + (2 pi x 1)/4 + 1 = 2 + pi/2 = 3.571 km.
Constant speed v0 with changing direction allowed; test on uniform circular motion.

(a) after one full revolution the displacement and average velocity are zero -> false. (b) velocity changes direction -> non-zero average acceleration -> false. (c) displacements in equal intervals have equal size but different directions -> false.
(d) path length = v0 x (interval), so equal intervals give equal path lengths -> true. Answer (d).
